intent: Restore responsive privacy switches, provider settings and new-chat entry by isolating local persistence and account setup I/O from UI interactions, retaining privacy dispatch checks and selectable profiles.

diagnostic_evidence.finding: 11 privacy-related StrictMode DiskReadViolation records; six during settings composition and five during OpenRouter setup. No fatal exception or ANR in supplied capture; permanent navigation lockout not proven by logs alone.

scope: Background serialized privacy-setting mutations with visible save error/retry
Asynchronous provider setup summary and IO-confined account setup
Privacy on/off, pending/failing verification and navigation/creation regressions
Allow local GitHub workspace opening and Research draft creation while preserving actual external-service privacy gates, plugin permissions and provider activation

validation.host: PASS: 615 canonical repository host tests plus generated inventories, regex, resources/icons, dependency provenance and whitespace; 13 PrivacyModeStore, seven PrivacySettingsWriter and 20 OpenRouterPrivacySetup actual-production-source tests (40 focused total). Focused Kotlin suites use real Kotlin/coroutines/MockK/JUnit with narrow Android/authority boundaries.
validation.android: Local full-app Gradle reached app:kspDebugKotlin then its daemon disappeared; no full-app Android, Hilt, packaging or device pass claimed. The isolated production Compose component build/test passed separately.
validation.ui: PASS: two actual ProviderVerificationSetup Compose/Robolectric tests using Android API 34 and real Compose/Parcelize compilers: saved status read failure/retry and rejection of stale profile results. PENDING: full-app NewChatViewModel tests and profile-card device instrumentation; the isolated NewChat model graph exceeded 300 sources and was not replaced with synthetic policy implementations.

review: Independent review verified immediate intent precedes queued persistence, short state lock never waits for disk, older completions cannot revert a newer revision, retries persist current intent, and optional diagnostics cannot terminate the writer.
transport_enforcement: AgentToolResolver, AgentRunner and ToolExecutionBudget dispatch checks
